title: Putnami Project Configuration
description: Project-level configuration file (putnami.json). Placed in a project directory to configure project identity, metadata, and job options.

name.description: Project name. Required for Go projects (which lack a native name field). Overrides native manifest for others.

type.description: Project type. Libraries cannot be served; image projects package declared OCI inputs without a compiled application. Defaults to "application" when omitted.

publish.description: Publish channels enabled for this project (e.g., 'npm', 'docker').

runsWith.description: Runtime service dependencies — project names that should be served alongside this project.

from.description: Source path for asset files (glob pattern). Relative to project root or absolute from workspace root.

assets.description: External asset paths that should trigger rebuild when changed.

compile.description: Executable compile targets. Map source entrypoint -> output filename (relative to build output).

dependencies.description: Workspace project dependencies. Source of truth, auto-maintained by scanning sources.

extensions.description: Extension names this project uses. Required for native projects (Go, Python) to enable extension jobs.

registries.description: Registry endpoints overriding the workspace 'registries' section for this project, one entry per ecosystem id. The override replaces the workspace entry whole; the keys inside it are defined by that ecosystem's profile.

visibility.description: Who may import this project. "scope" (the default) allows the projects of its own scope; "public" allows the whole workspace. It governs real imports (go.mod require or replace, package.json dependency on a workspace package), never declared dependencies. A generated client's contract edge is always allowed, and a generated client that declares no visibility is importable from every scope.

distribution.description: Who may pull what this project publishes. Unrelated to 'visibility', which is an import boundary inside the workspace.

visibility.description: Distribution level of every release-set member this project produces. It wins over a scope's declaration and over a putnami.ci.json distribution.members[] rule; a members[] rule that selects this project must agree with it.

options.description: Per-command and per-extension parameter defaults for this project. Keys: command names ('build'), extension names ('@putnami/typescript'), or qualified names ('@putnami/typescript:build').

jobs.description: Accepted but ignored. Project-level job definitions are not implemented: the key never reaches planning, and the CLI warns when a project declares it. Use 'disable.jobs' to opt out of an extension-provided job, or 'tasks' for per-project execution tuning.

tasks.description: Per-task execution tuning for this project. Keys are job names: a full step name ('build~transpile') or a command name ('lint'), which applies to every step of that command unless a more specific step entry exists.

disable.description: Opt-out configuration for jobs in this project.

jobs.description: Jobs to disable for this project. Supports job names ('lint') or qualified names ('@putnami/typescript:lint').

featureAuthority.description: Why this project declares no user-facing feature of its own. Set exactly one member. Absent means the project is expected to declare a feature.

owner.description: The authored feature ID this project contributes to, when the declaration lives in another project.

none.description: Why this project deliberately has no user-facing feature.

taskTuning.description: Execution tuning for one task in this project.

cpuWeight.description: Relative multiplier on deterministic, history-derived CPU demand. 1 is the default; 4 gives an otherwise identical task four times the CPU budget, capped by machine capacity. Execution hint only — never affects cache keys.

timeoutMs.description: Scheduler deadline for this task, in milliseconds, overriding the extension manifest for this project. Must be positive: 0 (use the CLI default) and negative values (no deadline) are manifest-only sentinels. Execution hint only — never affects cache keys.
